senses.gloss: ch. same, to make bald; to become bald.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 110a:14">Pes. 110ᵃ</cite> bot. (in an incantation) <he>ק׳ קרחייכי</he> bald be your baldness (may the hair with which you practice your witchcraft fall out).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 20:5:2">Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17ᵈ</cite> (perh. Hebrew) <he>קְרוֹחַ קריחה</he> make bald a bald head (?), v. <cite ref="R00623"><he>צְנִינִים</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:13">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דקרחא</he> some ed., read: <he>דקדחא</he>, v. <cite ref="S00126"><he>קְדַח</he></cite>.]
